name: 2D-Lift-3D Scene Segmentation
definition: Segments Gaussian primitives in 3D by lifting 2D segmentation masks from a reference view using SAM and multi-view label voting.
summary: 2D-Lift-3D Scene Segmentation is a training-free method that segments 3D Gaussian primitives by lifting 2D masks into 3D space and using multi-view label voting, avoiding learnable feature optimization.
